_help: Real-world work that isn't on job boards: student jobs, volunteering, companies to contact directly, communities. Shown in the tracker's Opportunities tab. city: melbourne | jakarta | any. kind: student | volunteer | company | community. Links are checked by the daily run; dead ones are flagged.

items.title: Monash Jobs for Students
items.why: Casual jobs inside the university for registered Monash students. Sign up once, then get offered shifts.

items.title: Monash Career Connect: find a job
items.why: Casual, part-time and vacation work, plus internships, posted for Monash students.

items.title: Monash student jobs board
items.why: The student jobs board (log in with his Monash account).

items.title: Monash Student Association jobs (Clayton)
items.why: MSA hires students on campus; shifts fit around study.

items.title: SEEK Volunteer: IT & tech roles
items.why: Australia's biggest volunteer board. Search 'IT' or 'digital' in Melbourne: IT support, websites and digital-skills roles at charities.

items.title: Pro Bono Australia: volunteer roles
items.why: Use its volunteer-role search: skilled volunteering for non-profits, often IT support or web projects, some remote.

items.title: Australian Red Cross: volunteer
items.why: Has advertised IT service desk volunteer roles in Melbourne: real help-desk experience.

items.title: Be Connected (digital mentors)
items.why: Government programme where local groups need volunteers to teach older people online safety and tech skills.

items.title: OWASP Melbourne
items.why: Melbourne's application-security community. Go to a meetup and offer to help run events: the fastest way to meet people who hire.

items.title: AISA (Australian Information Security Association)
items.why: Australia's cyber professional body: student membership, Victorian branch events, and volunteers at its conference.

items.title: CyberCX
items.why: Australia's largest cyber consultancy, with a Melbourne office.

items.title: Data#3
items.why: IT services and security provider with a Melbourne office; hires service-desk and junior roles.

items.title: Interactive
items.why: Melbourne-founded IT services and managed-security company.

items.title: Nexon Asia Pacific
items.why: Managed IT and cyber services provider; MSPs like this take juniors for help-desk work.

items.title: Relawan TIK Indonesia
items.why: National ICT-volunteer network (digital literacy, community tech help) with Jakarta activities.

items.title: Indorelawan
items.why: Indonesia's volunteer-matching platform: search for IT, web and digital roles in Jakarta.

items.title: Siberkreasi
items.why: National digital-literacy movement; runs online-safety education with volunteers.

items.title: OWASP Jakarta
items.why: Jakarta's application-security community: meetups and people who hire security interns.

items.title: ITSEC Asia
items.why: Indonesian cybersecurity company (pentest, SOC); has taken security research interns.

items.title: Defenxor
items.why: Jakarta managed-security (SOC) provider.

items.title: Spentera
items.why: Jakarta penetration-testing and security consultancy.

items.title: Xynexis
items.why: Indonesian cybersecurity consultancy (GRC, SOC, pentest).

items.title: Telkomsigma
items.why: Large IT services and data-centre company (Telkom group) with security services.

items.title: Lintasarta
items.why: IT, cloud and managed-security provider.

items.title: Datacomm Diangraha
items.why: IT infrastructure and security services company.

items.title: Mitra Integrasi Informatika (MII)
items.why: IT services company (Metrodata group); takes interns and juniors.

items.title: BCA careers
items.why: Bank Central Asia's careers site: IT and security teams, internship programmes.

items.title: KPMG Indonesia careers
items.why: Big 4 with IT-risk and cyber teams.
